questions.q: According to this lesson, where does analytics engineering sit?
options: Between data engineering (getting data in) and data analysis (pulling data out)
It replaces data engineering entirely
It is identical to data analysis with a different job title
It only exists inside BI tools like Power BI
questions.explain: Analytics engineering is the middle layer — transforming loaded data into trusted, modeled data that analysts and BI tools consume.

questions.q: What does dbt's Lineage graph actually show, and where does it come from?
options: The real dependency graph, generated automatically from ref() calls in the SQL itself
A manually drawn diagram that must be updated by hand
A random visualization unrelated to the actual project
A list of every user who has access to the project
questions.explain: The lineage graph is generated directly from ref() calls, so it's always accurate and never goes stale, unlike a hand-drawn diagram.

questions.q: In one sentence, what problem does dbt solve, according to this lesson?
options: It turns SQL transformation logic into version-controlled, tested, documented, and automatically ordered models
It replaces the need for a data warehouse entirely
It only exists to make dashboards prettier
It writes SQL queries automatically with no human input
questions.explain: dbt brings software-engineering rigor — version control, testing, documentation, ordering — to SQL transformation logic.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the four things this lesson says dbt adds over raw SQL scripts?
options: Automatic dashboard generation
Dependency management via ref()
Testing
Documentation
questions.explain: dbt adds dependency management, testing, documentation, and version control/CI/CD — it does not generate dashboards.

questions.q: What does this course assume you already know coming in?
options: Real SQL fluency and cloud warehouse basics, from T-SQL Development and the Snowflake course
Nothing at all — it starts SQL from zero
A different transformation tool entirely
Advanced Python programming
questions.explain: This course builds directly on SQL and Snowflake knowledge from earlier in the Analytics Engineer path — it doesn't re-teach SQL.
